title: Troposphere Sandbox

text.TAG: Steer the winds, brew hurricanes and tornadoes, and change the climate of a whole planet
text.FREE: The full sandbox: heat and cool the air, spin up storms, raise mountains and change the greenhouse
text.WATCH: A tour of global winds, a category 5 hurricane, tornado alley, an ice age and a planet with no night
text.FOOT: Simplified but real meteorology: sunlight and seasons, pressure and the Coriolis effect, evaporation, clouds and rain, storms and the greenhouse effect.
text.FIND: Find a storm, place or weather…
